stem: What time does Mia want to play tennis, and where will they meet?
source: Hi Sam, it's Mia. I'm calling about Saturday. We can't play tennis in the morning because my brother has the car. Can we play at three o'clock in the afternoon instead? Let's meet at the sports centre, not the park. Bring your racket and some water, because it's going to be hot. Call me back tonight, please. Bye!
points: At three o'clock in the afternoon
At the sports centre
model_answer: Mia wants to play at three o'clock in the afternoon, and they will meet at the sports centre.

stem: Why is the library closed today, and when will it open again?
source: Good morning, everyone. This is Mrs Patel. Today the school library is closed because we are painting the walls. It will open again on Thursday. If you want to return a book, please give it to your class teacher. Also, the Year 5 football match is on Friday after lunch, not on Wednesday. Thank you.
points: Because the walls are being painted
It opens again on Thursday
model_answer: The library is closed today because they are painting the walls. It will open again on Thursday.

stem: How much does the woman pay, and why doesn't she buy bananas?
source: A: Hello, how much are these apples? B: They're two pounds a kilo. A: OK, I'd like one kilo, please. And do you have any bananas? B: Sorry, no bananas today. They come tomorrow morning. A: Fine. Just the apples, then. B: That's two pounds, please. A: Here you are. Thank you!
points: She pays two pounds
The shop has no bananas today (they come tomorrow)
model_answer: She pays two pounds. She doesn't buy bananas because the shop has no bananas today; they arrive tomorrow morning.

stem: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon in the north and in the south?
source: And now the weather for tomorrow. In the morning it will be cold and cloudy, about six degrees. In the afternoon there will be rain in the north, so take an umbrella. In the south it will be dry and sunny, with temperatures up to twelve degrees. On Sunday there will be strong wind everywhere.
points: Rain in the north
Dry and sunny in the south (up to twelve degrees)
model_answer: Tomorrow afternoon it will rain in the north, so you need an umbrella. In the south it will be dry and sunny, up to twelve degrees.

stem: Who does Tom live with, and what does he do on Saturdays?
source: Hi, my name is Tom. I'm eleven years old and I live in a small flat with my mum and my sister, Lucy. Lucy is fifteen. We have a cat called Biscuit. He is orange and very lazy. After school I like playing computer games, but on Saturdays I go swimming with my dad. He lives near the beach.
points: With his mum and his sister (Lucy)
He goes swimming with his dad
model_answer: Tom lives with his mum and his sister Lucy. On Saturdays he goes swimming with his dad.

stem: Which platform does the Brighton train leave from, and is it on time?
source: Attention, please. The ten fifteen train to Brighton will leave from platform four, not platform two. This train is running about ten minutes late. Please do not stand near the edge of the platform. The café on platform one is open until eleven o'clock. Thank you.
points: Platform four
No, it is about ten minutes late
model_answer: The Brighton train leaves from platform four. It is not on time; it is about ten minutes late.

stem: When is Mr Jones's appointment, when should he arrive, and what should he bring?
source: Hello, this is a message for Mr Jones from Smile Dental. Your appointment is on Tuesday the fourteenth at half past nine. Please arrive ten minutes early. Remember to bring your insurance card. If you can't come, please call us on 0161 555 2840. Thank you, goodbye.
points: Tuesday the fourteenth at half past nine
Ten minutes early
His insurance card
model_answer: His appointment is on Tuesday the fourteenth at half past nine. He should arrive ten minutes early and bring his insurance card.

stem: Where and when are the friends meeting, and why?
source: A: Hi Jess, are we still going to the cinema tonight? B: Yes, but the film starts at eight, not half past seven. A: OK. Shall we meet at the bus stop? B: No, let's meet at the pizza place next to the cinema at seven. We can eat first. A: Great idea. I'll ask Ben too. B: Good. See you later!
points: At the pizza place next to the cinema
At seven o'clock
So they can eat before the film
model_answer: They are meeting at the pizza place next to the cinema at seven o'clock, so they can eat before the film starts at eight.

stem: How much are the tickets, and on which day is the museum closed?
source: Welcome to the City Museum. The museum is open every day from nine to five, except Mondays. Tickets cost eight pounds for adults, and children under twelve go in free. The dinosaur exhibition is on the second floor. Please don't take photos with flash. Our gift shop is next to the main entrance.
points: Adult tickets cost eight pounds (children under twelve are free)
It is closed on Mondays
model_answer: Tickets cost eight pounds for adults, and children under twelve go in free. The museum is closed on Mondays.

stem: What did Daniel lose, and what does it look like?
source: Hello, I'm calling the lost property office. I left my bag on the number 42 bus this morning. It's a small black backpack with a red key ring on it. Inside there's my laptop and a blue notebook. My name is Daniel Brooks, and my phone number is 07700 900 318. Please call me if you find it.
points: His bag (a backpack) on the number 42 bus
It is a small black backpack with a red key ring
model_answer: Daniel lost his bag, a backpack, on the number 42 bus. It is small and black with a red key ring, and it has his laptop and a blue notebook inside.

stem: When is basketball practice this week, and why has it changed?
source: Hi everyone, this is Coach Rivera. Basketball practice this week is on Wednesday, not Tuesday, because the gym is being used for exams. We'll start at four fifteen and finish at half past five. Please bring your own water bottle, because the water fountain is broken. And don't forget, the match against Hillside School is next Saturday.
points: On Wednesday, from four fifteen to half past five
Because the gym is being used for exams
model_answer: This week practice is on Wednesday from four fifteen to half past five. It changed because the gym is being used for exams.

stem: What room is the guest in, when is breakfast, and how does she get the Wi-Fi password?
source: A: Good evening, I have a reservation. The name is Kowalski. B: Yes, a double room for three nights. You're in room two-one-four on the second floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant downstairs. A: Is there Wi-Fi? B: Yes, it's free. The password is on your key card. A: And what time is check-out? B: Check-out is at eleven.
points: Room 214 (second floor)
From seven to ten in the restaurant downstairs
The password is on her key card
model_answer: She is in room 214 on the second floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant downstairs, and the Wi-Fi password is on her key card.

stem: Where does the new bike lane go, and what does the mayor hope?
source: Good news for cyclists in Riverton. From the first of June, the town will open a new bike lane along the river. It is three kilometres long and goes from the train station to the university. The project cost two million pounds. The mayor says she hopes more students will cycle instead of driving, and that this will make the town centre less busy.
points: From the train station to the university (along the river)
That more students will cycle instead of driving (and the centre will be less busy)
model_answer: The new bike lane goes along the river from the train station to the university. The mayor hopes more students will cycle instead of driving, so the town centre will be less busy.

stem: Why is the class cancelled, and when will it happen instead?
source: Hi Anna, it's Leo from the cooking school. I'm afraid tomorrow's Italian class is cancelled because the chef is sick. We'll do it next Thursday at the same time, six o'clock. You don't need to pay again. Oh, and next time please bring an apron, because we've run out. See you then!
points: Because the chef is sick
Next Thursday at six o'clock
model_answer: The class is cancelled because the chef is sick. It will happen next Thursday at the same time, six o'clock.

stem: What is the problem with the jacket, and what does the customer decide to do?
source: A: Hi, I bought this jacket here last week, but it's too small. Can I change it? B: Of course. Do you have the receipt? A: Yes, here it is. B: Thanks. I'm sorry, we don't have this jacket in a large size now. You can choose a different jacket, or I can give you your money back. A: I'll take the money back, please. B: No problem. It'll be on your card in three to five days.
points: The jacket is too small
She takes her money back (a refund)
model_answer: The jacket is too small. Because the shop has no large size, she decides to take her money back; it will be on her card in three to five days.

stem: What time should students be at the main gate, what do they need to bring, and who do the permission forms go to?
source: Attention, Year 9 students. The science trip to the Natural History Museum is next Friday, the twenty-first. The coach leaves from the main gate at eight o'clock sharp, so please be there by a quarter to eight. The trip costs fifteen pounds, which covers the coach and entry. You need to bring a packed lunch, because there is no time to buy food. Permission forms must be returned to Mr Ahmed by Wednesday. We'll be back at school at around four.
points: By a quarter to eight
A packed lunch
To Mr Ahmed (by Wednesday)
model_answer: Students should be at the main gate by a quarter to eight. They need to bring a packed lunch, and the permission forms go to Mr Ahmed by Wednesday.

stem: Give two reasons why Maria wants the job, and say when she can start.
source: Interviewer: So, why do you want to work at the summer camp? Maria: Well, I've worked with children before. Last year I helped at my local swimming club, teaching kids aged six to ten, and I really enjoyed it. I'm also studying to be a primary school teacher, so I think this job would give me useful experience. Interviewer: And are you available for the whole of July? Maria: Most of it. I have an exam on the third, so I could start on the fifth.
points: She has worked with children before and enjoyed it (swimming club)
She is studying to be a primary teacher, so the job gives useful experience
She can start on the fifth of July
model_answer: Maria has worked with children before at a swimming club and enjoyed it, and she is studying to be a primary school teacher, so the job would give her useful experience. She can start on the fifth of July.

stem: What is wrong with the car, how much will the repair cost, and when will the car be ready?
source: Hi, Mrs Green, it's Pete from Central Garage. We've looked at your car. The brakes are fine, but the battery is very old and needs replacing. That'll be about ninety pounds, including labour. If you're happy with that, we can do it this afternoon and the car will be ready tomorrow morning after ten. Just give us a ring to say yes.
points: The battery is very old and needs replacing
About ninety pounds (including labour)
Tomorrow morning after ten
model_answer: The battery is very old and needs replacing. It will cost about ninety pounds including labour, and the car will be ready tomorrow morning after ten.

stem: What can members do with the new app, and what do they need to use it?
source: The city library has launched a new mobile app. With the app, members can borrow e-books and audiobooks for up to three weeks, and they can renew printed books without visiting the library. The app is free, but you need a library card to log in. Librarians say the app is especially useful for people who live far from the city centre. Next month, they plan to add a feature for booking study rooms.
points: Borrow e-books and audiobooks (for up to three weeks)
Renew printed books without visiting the library
They need a library card to log in
model_answer: With the app, members can borrow e-books and audiobooks for up to three weeks and renew printed books without visiting the library. The app is free, but they need a library card to log in.

stem: Why is the flight delayed, what is the new departure time, and where can passengers get a voucher?
source: This is an announcement for passengers on flight BA 472 to Madrid. Due to a technical problem with the aircraft, this flight is delayed by approximately two hours. The new departure time is fifteen forty. Passengers can collect a ten-euro food voucher from the information desk next to gate twelve. We will announce the new boarding gate at fourteen fifty. We apologise for the inconvenience.
points: A technical problem with the aircraft
At the information desk next to gate 12
model_answer: The flight is delayed because of a technical problem with the aircraft. The new departure time is 15:40, and passengers can get a ten-euro food voucher at the information desk next to gate 12.

stem: According to the speaker, how should you review new words, and why should you learn them in a sentence?
source: Today's tip is about learning new words. Many students write long lists and try to memorise them the night before a test. Research shows this doesn't work well. It's much better to review new words several times over a few days, for example one day, three days and a week after you first learn them. Another tip: always learn a word in a sentence, not alone, because then you'll remember how to use it.
points: Review them several times over a few days (e.g. after one day, three days and a week), not all the night before
Because you will remember how to use the word
model_answer: You should review new words several times over a few days, for example one day, three days and a week after learning them, instead of memorising a list the night before a test. You should learn them in a sentence because then you remember how to use them.

stem: Why is the bill higher than last time, how much does each person pay, and when will B pay?
source: A: Hey, the electricity bill came. It's a hundred and twenty pounds for three months. B: That's more than last time. A: Yes, because we used the heater a lot in January. So that's forty each, since there are three of us. B: OK. Can I pay you on Friday? I get paid then. A: Sure. But Mark's away until the fifteenth, so he'll pay later. B: Fine. Maybe we should turn the heater off at night.
points: They used the heater a lot in January
Forty pounds each
On Friday (when B gets paid)
model_answer: The bill is higher because they used the heater a lot in January. Each person pays forty pounds, and B will pay on Friday, when B gets paid.

stem: When and where do the volunteers meet, and what do they need to wear?
source: Hello, I'm Sara from Green Streets. Every second Sunday of the month, we clean up the park by the river. Volunteers meet at the north entrance at ten. We give you gloves and bags, so you only need to wear old clothes and comfortable shoes. Last year our volunteers collected more than two tonnes of rubbish. This year we also want to plant fifty trees, so we need more people, especially on weekends in spring.
points: On the second Sunday of every month at ten
At the north entrance of the park
Old clothes and comfortable shoes (gloves and bags are provided)
model_answer: Volunteers meet on the second Sunday of every month at ten o'clock at the north entrance of the park by the river. They need to wear old clothes and comfortable shoes, because gloves and bags are given to them.

stem: How did the café solve the takeaway problem, and what is its biggest challenge now?
source: Interviewer: Your café is famous for having no single-use cups. Was that difficult? Owner: At first, yes. We lost some customers who wanted takeaway coffee in a hurry. But then we started a deposit scheme: you pay one pound for a reusable cup, and you get the pound back when you return it. Within six months, our takeaway sales were higher than before. People liked that it was simple. The biggest challenge now is actually washing all the cups. We had to buy a second dishwasher.
points: A deposit scheme: pay one pound for a reusable cup and get it back when you return the cup
Washing all the cups (they bought a second dishwasher)
model_answer: They started a deposit scheme: customers pay one pound for a reusable cup and get the pound back when they return it, and takeaway sales rose within six months. The biggest challenge now is washing all the cups, so they bought a second dishwasher.

stem: What did the scientists find, and why are they still worried?
source: Scientists in Norway have found that a small fish living near the coast can survive in water several degrees warmer than expected. The team, from the University of Bergen, studied the fish for eighteen months. However, they warn that although the fish survives, it produces far fewer eggs in warmer water. This could reduce the population over time and affect the seabirds that feed on it. The researchers now plan to study three other species.
points: The fish can survive in water several degrees warmer than expected
It produces far fewer eggs in warmer water
This could reduce the population and affect seabirds that eat it
model_answer: They found that the fish can survive in water several degrees warmer than expected. They are worried because it produces far fewer eggs in warmer water, which could reduce the population and affect the seabirds that feed on it.

stem: Why do teenagers tend to sleep late, and what happened when some schools started later?
source: Teenagers are often called lazy for sleeping late, but there's a biological reason. During adolescence, the body releases melatonin, the sleep hormone, about two hours later than in children or adults. So a teenager may simply not feel tired until eleven or midnight. Some schools in the US moved their start time from seven thirty to eight thirty, and found that attendance improved and students were less sleepy in class. Critics, though, point out that later start times make it harder for parents who work early.
points: The body releases melatonin about two hours later in adolescence
Attendance improved
Students were less sleepy in class
model_answer: Teenagers sleep late because during adolescence the body releases melatonin about two hours later than in children or adults, so they don't feel tired until eleven or midnight. When some schools started at eight thirty instead of seven thirty, attendance improved and students were less sleepy in class.

stem: Why was the bill so high, what should the customer do, and what will happen to any overpaid money?
source: Thank you for calling Northline Energy. I can see your last bill was estimated, because we couldn't access your meter in March. That's why it seems so high. If you send us a photo of your meter reading today, we'll recalculate the bill within five working days. Any money you've overpaid will be returned to your account, not to your bank, unless you ask us to.
points: It was estimated because they couldn't access the meter in March
Send a photo of the meter reading (bill recalculated within five working days)
It goes back to the customer's account, not the bank, unless they ask
model_answer: The bill was high because it was estimated; they couldn't access the meter in March. The customer should send a photo of the meter reading, and the bill will be recalculated within five working days. Overpaid money goes back to the customer's account, not the bank, unless they ask.

stem: What was the main reason people wanted to work from home, and why were younger workers less keen?
source: A recent survey of two thousand office workers found that sixty percent would prefer to work from home at least three days a week. Interestingly, the main reason was not saving time on commuting, but being able to concentrate better without interruptions. However, younger workers, under twenty-five, were less keen. Many said they missed learning from more experienced colleagues and felt lonely at home.
points: To concentrate better without interruptions (not commuting)
They missed learning from more experienced colleagues
They felt lonely at home
model_answer: The main reason was being able to concentrate better without interruptions, not saving commuting time. Younger workers were less keen because they missed learning from more experienced colleagues and felt lonely at home.

stem: Why was the painting hidden, what damaged it, and why was one area left unrestored?
source: This painting was finished in 1889, but it was almost lost. In the 1940s it was hidden in a farmhouse to protect it during the war. When it was found again in 1962, the canvas was badly damaged by damp. Restorers spent four years repairing it. Today, if you look closely at the bottom left corner, you can still see a small area they decided not to restore, to show visitors the original damage.
points: To protect it during the war
Damp
To show visitors the original damage
model_answer: It was hidden in a farmhouse to protect it during the war. Damp damaged the canvas. One small area was left unrestored to show visitors the original damage.

stem: Which ferry crossings are cancelled and why, and what can passengers with cancelled tickets do?
source: Due to strong winds forecast for this afternoon, all ferry crossings to the island after two p.m. are cancelled. The eleven thirty and twelve forty-five sailings will still run, but may be uncomfortable. Passengers with tickets for cancelled sailings can travel tomorrow at no extra cost, or request a full refund online. The café and shop at the terminal will close early, at three p.m.
points: All crossings after 2 p.m., because of strong winds
Travel tomorrow at no extra cost
Request a full refund online
model_answer: All crossings after 2 p.m. are cancelled because strong winds are forecast. Passengers with cancelled tickets can travel tomorrow at no extra cost or request a full refund online.
